## Description

Voluntarily revokes a user token before it would otherwise expire, typically because the user has unsubscribed or because of security concerns. See Getting Tokens for a detailed description of how to obtain user tokens.

**Purpose:**
Voluntarily revokes a user token before it would otherwise expire, typically because the user has unsubscribed or because of security concerns. See Getting Tokens for a detailed description of how to obtain user tokens. Unlike other Traditional API calls, RevokeToken requires your application keys ( AppID , DevID , and CERT ), as well as an eBayAuthToken value that you want to revoke.

**Use Cases:**
- Revokes an existing user token.
- Mapping exists but target API name is still Unknown.
